rules.expected: For a completed report, both AQ and EQ structures, charge/state and conformer provenance are explicit and auditable; a bounded-failure report instead identifies each attempted object and blocked field without fabricated values.
For each completed object, state assignment, S1-minus-T1 arithmetic, units and geometry validation are shown; bounded failure documents attempted scope and evidence.
Donor-localized HOMO, acceptor-localized LUMO, and the stated EQ/AQ electronic comparison are supported for both named systems when available.
Final conclusion is quantitative, object-specific, evidence-linked and scope-qualified, or clearly reports bounded failure and its scientific limitation.
